FIELD.NAME: enable_enrol
FIELD.COMMENT: Active or not the plugin for each course

FIELD.NAME: settings
FIELD.COMMENT: Groups as an indexed array with LTI tools as keys

FIELD.NAME: backfill_time
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the last backfill run of the course finished

FIELD.NAME: backfill_result
FIELD.COMMENT: Counters of the last backfill run as JSON (no user data)

FIELD.NAME: event_errors
FIELD.COMMENT: Group memberships of new enrolments that could not be added since event_errortime

FIELD.NAME: event_errortime
FIELD.COMMENT: Time of the first unresolved failure of the enrolment observer

KEY.NAME: courseid
KEY.COMMENT: At most one configuration per course
